summary: Full stack testing of WhatsApp Inbox (Phase C) + Phase A feature verification. Backend: all 12 WhatsApp inbox/conversation/delivery-status endpoint tests passed (100%). Frontend: WhatsApp Inbox page loads at /whatsapp/inbox with 3 conversation threads, unread badge '2 new', conversation messages render correctly (chat bubbles), reply bar + Send button visible. Sidebar nav shows 'WhatsApp Inbox' above 'WhatsApp Bot'. QueueBoard WaTick component exists in code but no today's appointments to test live (all appointments are dated in past). AmbientAI 'Listening in English (India)...' label is implemented in code and visible when recording active - cannot be automated without mic permission. Cash Calculator exists in CollectPaymentDialog.js with amount-tendered field but shows only when payment method is 'cash' (sarah@test.com defaults to UPI so QR modal shows). 'Test Gateway' button label is actually 'Verify Connection' in the UI (only visible when a gateway is saved).
